description: Canonical byte-identity golden (RFC semiring-faq-unified-ir §5.5 / §5.7; CONFORMANCE_SPEC.md §5.5.3) for the FULL DUO icosahedral mesh at subdivision level 1, produced by folding the one-level value-invention refine pass (subdivide_refine.esm) 1 time(s) from the base icosahedron seed (subdivide_fold.esm: 12 golden-ratio vertices + 20 faces). `faces_canonical` is the (3 x n_cells) cell->vertex connectivity serialized as a compact JSON array of 1-based vertex-id triples, under the §5.7 canonical (sorted-edge) vertex labeling — base vertices keep their seed ids, each pass appends midpoint vertices in distinct+rank order, so the labeling is deterministic and cross-binding stable (the imperative push!/Dict order is NOT). Every conforming binding (Julia / Rust / Python) folding the refine pass from the canonical seed MUST reproduce these exact bytes, independent of face iteration order or triangle winding. Counts match icos_level1.esm (n_cells = 20*4^1). Pinned by test/test_duo_subdivision_fold.jl.
